summary: The study presents a kinetic model for atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) of silicon using cyclic exposures of SiH2Cl2 and atomic hydrogen. The model considers both surface and gas-phase reactions, and the growth rate of one monolayer per cycle is achieved when the dominant precursor is SiHC1. The ALE window is limited by thermal desorption of surface species.
evidence: The ideal growth rate of one monolayer per cycle is achieved only when the dominant precursor is SiHC1. Limiting factors of the ALE window are also discussed.
